name: Luo-Rudnick-Sarnak exponent count on a rank-one eigen-object attached to a zero (weight-1/2 Eisenstein series at 1/4 + rho/2, theta-orthogonality in place of cuspidality; any cover, any vector)
evidence: lane c14-theta-orthogonal-metaplectic-eigenobject (round 14; author's second pass only). Stage A stops. The vanishing row D = 1 is one linear condition b(1) = 0 propagated by the Hecke relation at squares; it removes the first-moment series and no polar term of the second-moment series. Rightmost Rankin-Selberg pole P = 1 + |beta - 1/2|, gamma pole |beta - 1/2|, difference 1. Lemma E: the difference is 1 for every moderate-growth Laplace eigenfunction with non-real eigenvalue on any finite-volume rank-one quotient. The generic parameter passes every step of the count; the sieved local vector NR-vec has a vanishing square row at every parameter.
reads: Hecke relation at p^2, all odd p (identity)
zeta(rho) = 0 as one vanishing Whittaker coefficient
